newsitem.title: FRANCE: Depardieu stars in pricey TF1 Monte Cristo remake.
newsitem.headline: Depardieu stars in pricey TF1 Monte Cristo remake.

text.p: French private television station TF1, facing intense competition in audience-winning prime-time fiction, is using actor Gerard Depardieu for a remake of the Count of Monte Cristo which will be the most expensive TV fiction production in France.

Depardieu will play the lead role of Edmond Dantes and co-produce the mini-series, which has a provisional budget of 90 million francs, Jean-Pierre Ozannat, chairman of production house Europe Audiovisuel, told journalists at the MIP television fair here on Sunday.
TF1 will put up 50 million francs for the production, while Silvio Berlusconi's Mediaset will invest 31 million francs, TF1 vice-chairman Etienne Mougeotte told a news conference.
The remainder is to come from other partners, notably German, with whom TF1 is currently negotiating, he said.
"You can do major productions like this for television, but not any more for cinema," Depardieu told journalists.
Shooting is due to start at the end of June and finish at the beginning of October.
The series, to be broadcast in 1998, will be made up of four episodes of 90 minutes each.
